text: dsh-doc-reader 是面向 DSH 的文档处理工具插件，在 tools 接口注册五个工具，可把本地文件或 HTTP(S) 地址中的 PDF、DOCX、XLSX、PPTX、TXT、Markdown、CSV 和 HTML 转成带页码、工作表或幻灯片结构的文本。它还可读取文档元数据，并对扫描 PDF 与常见图片执行 OCR，返回识别文本和置信度。用户可以选择页面、工作表、行数和输出长度，适合让 agent 查阅报告、表格、演示稿或扫描资料。使用 OCR 时首次会下载语言数据并保存在本地缓存；传入 URL 时会从该地址获取文档，不需要 API 密钥。

dsh-doc-reader adds five DSH tools to extract structured text and metadata from local or HTTP(S) PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, text, and HTML files. Choose pages or sheets, or use OCR for scanned PDFs and images. First OCR use downloads language data to a local cache; no API key is required.
想让 DSH 直接读取 PDF、Word、Excel 和演示文稿里的文字。
扫描版 PDF 没有可复制文本时，怎样提取里面的内容？
I need an agent to inspect selected spreadsheet tabs and return their rows as readable text.
dsh-doc-reader 的功能「文档转文本」：调用 doc_read 或专用读取工具，输入本地路径或 URL，可选择 PDF 页面、XLSX 工作表及输出上限，得到按页面、表格或幻灯片组织的内容。
dsh-doc-reader 的功能「扫描件 OCR」：调用 doc_ocr 并提供 PDF 或图片路径，可选页码、识别语言和缩放比例，获得识别文本及页面置信度。
dsh-doc-reader 使用 URL 输入时会向所提供的 HTTP(S) 地址发起请求并读取返回文档；需要在线文档时才会产生这项外部数据传输。
OCR 首次启动会获取所选语言的训练数据并写入本机缓存；可用 DSH_DOC_READER_OCR_LANG_PATH 指定已有语言文件目录。

Read PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX and text documents as agent tools for **DeepSeek Harness (dsh)**.

dsh-doc-reader README · dsh-doc-reader：The built-in `read` tool returns file text, and `web_fetch` rejects `application/pdf` — so a PDF, a spreadsheet or a slide deck currently ends up as `curl` + `pip install pypdf` inside the session. This plugin closes that gap with five typed tools that return page-, sheet- and slide-aware text, including local OCR for scans and screenshots.

`doc_ocr` — local OCR for scans and images, with per-page confidence:

dsh-doc-reader README · Tools：| Tool | What it does | Key parameters |
|---|---|---|
| `doc_read` | Universal reader: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, TXT/MD/CSV/HTML; auto-detects format by magic bytes | `path` \| `url`, `format`, `pages`, `sheet`, `maxRows`, `maxChars` |
| `pdf_read` | PDF page by page with `--- page N/M ---` markers, title/author metadata | `path` \| `url`, `pages` (e.g. `"1-3,7"`), `maxChars` |
| `xlsx_read` | One block per sheet, tab-separated rows, sheet by name or 1-based index | `path` \| `url`, `sheet`, `maxRows`, `maxChars` |
| `doc_meta` | Metadata only: format, size, PDF page count/title, DOCX props, XLSX sheets, PPTX slide count | `path` \| `url`, `format` |
| `doc_ocr` | OCR for scanned PDFs and images (PNG/JPEG/WebP/BMP/TIFF/GIF), per-page confidence | `path` \| `url`, `pages`, `langs`, `scale`, `maxChars` |

dsh-doc-reader README · Tools：Every tool accepts a local path **or** an `http(s)` URL. Prefer `doc_meta` first for large files, then read the pages/sheets you need — output is capped by `maxChars` (default `60000`, hard cap `400000`).
dsh-doc-reader README · Example output：```text

dsh-doc-reader README · pages 1, 2 of 7 · title: Invoice 2026-10：--- page 1/7 ---
ACME Ltd — Invoice 0042
...
```

```text

dsh-doc-reader README · sheet "Data" — 3 rows × 3 cols：1 | Year | Revenue | Note
2 | 2024 | 1000    | ok
3 | 2025 | 2000    | Привет
```
dsh-doc-reader README · OCR：`doc_ocr` handles what pure text extraction cannot: scanned PDFs, photos and screenshots.

dsh-doc-reader README · OCR：- Engine: **tesseract.js 7** (WebAssembly, no native OCR binary) — runs fully locally, nothing is uploaded.
- PDF pages are rasterized with `pdf-to-img` (pdf.js + `@napi-rs/canvas`) at `scale` 2 (~200 DPI), then recognized with one shared worker.
- Fax-style **CCITT G4 and JBIG2** scans are decoded through pdf.js wasm/JS decoders (`wasmUrl` is wired to the installed `pdfjs-dist/wasm`), so two-tone scans rasterize instead of returning blank pages.
- Default languages: **`rus+eng`** (`langs` overrides, e.g. `"deu"`, `"eng"`). Order matters: with `eng+rus` tesseract reads uppercase Cyrillic as Latin lookalikes (`ПРИВЕТ` → `NMPUBET`); Cyrillic-first keeps Latin accuracy identical (measured 94–95% on both fixture sets).
- **First use downloads the language data** (~4 MB per language) into `~/.dsh/cache/dsh-doc-reader/tesseract`; later calls are fast (a page takes ~0.3–1 s). For offline machines set `DSH_DOC_READER_OCR_LANG_PATH` to a directory containing `<lang>.traineddata` (optionally `.gz`), and/or `DSH_DOC_READER_OCR_CACHE` for the cache location.
- At most **20 PDF pages per call**; narrow with `pages`. Use `scale: 1` for speed, `scale: 3` for small prin
dsh-doc-reader README · OCR：```text

dsh-doc-reader README · OCR: tesseract rus+eng · pages 1, 2 of 12：--- page 1/12 (ocr, 91.4%) ---
INVOICE 2026-042
...
```

dsh-doc-reader README · Limits and security：- Local files: up to **50 MB**; URLs: downloaded with a **20 s timeout** and the same 50 MB cap.
- **Private/local hosts are refused** (`localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, RFC1918, `.local`, `.internal`) so the tool cannot become an SSRF primitive. Download the file and pass a `path` instead.
- Only `http(s)` URLs.
- PDF text extraction is text-based: scanned PDFs (images only) return `(no extractable text on this page)` — use `doc_ocr` for those.
- DOCX conversion is handled by `mammoth`; charts, comments and tracked changes are not materialized as text.
- XLSX returns displayed values, not formulas; rows are paged with `maxRows`.

dsh-doc-reader README · Install：Published on npm as [`dsh-doc-reader`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-doc-reader). Install from the built-in plugin market, or manually into a profile:

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
npx pnpm add dsh-doc-reader
```

Then add the bundle to the profile's `package.json`:

```json
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["dsh-doc-reader", "..."] } }
```

Restart DSH (the plugin loads on boot; DSH composition is all-or-nothing). The five tools appear in the next session.

dsh-doc-reader README · Install：For local development, install the working copy instead: `npx pnpm add link:~/dsh-plugins/dsh-doc-reader`.

> pnpm 12 may report an ignored build script for `tesseract.js`. That postinstall is only the OpenCollective banner — approve it with `pnpm approve-builds` or ignore it; OCR works either way.

dsh-doc-reader README · Develop：```bash
npm install
npm test          # node --test, runs against test/fixtures
node --check index.js
```

The readers live in `lib/` and have no host dependency, so they can be exercised directly:

```js
import { readDocument, documentMeta } from "./lib/read.js";
await readDocument({ path: "report.pdf", pages: "1-3" });
```

`index.js` imports `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` for `defineTool`; outside a DSH host the import falls back to an identity definition (the registry consumes the plain object).

dsh-doc-reader README · Roadmap：- `.doc`, `.rtf`, `.odt`, `.epub` readers.
- Layout hints from OCR (word boxes, tables) and page-number citations.
- Page/sheet images for vision models (`presentResult` image parts).
- Caching of parsed documents within a session.
